description: Deterministic offline fixtures for validating Gold Rails reliability accounting. These are not observations of any provider.

scenarios.name: normal-success
scenarios.description: A normal response succeeds on the first attempt.

scenarios.name: throttle-then-recover
scenarios.description: A rate-limited request succeeds after one policy-controlled retry.

scenarios.name: server-errors-then-recover
scenarios.description: HTTP 500 and 503 failures recover on the third attempt.

scenarios.name: timeout-exhausted
scenarios.description: Every attempt times out, consuming the complete retry budget.

scenarios.name: connection-reset-then-recover
scenarios.description: A transport connection reset succeeds on the second attempt.

scenarios.name: slow-success
scenarios.description: The provider returns a usable result which violates a hypothetical one-second latency SLO.

scenarios.name: malformed-response
scenarios.description: An unusable response is final because repeating a non-transient adapter failure is wasteful.
